blocks.text: Maloomat ka akhlaqi istemal ka matlab data aur mawad ko munsifana aur qanooni tareeqe se sambhalna hai: data zimmedari se share karna aur copyright ka ehtaram aur plagiarism se bachna.

blocks.prompt: Maloomat ka akhlaqi istemal kya hai (MCQ 9)?
blocks.explanation: (b) copyright ka ehtaram aur plagiarism se bachna.

items: Akhlaqi istemal: data aur mawad ka munsifana, qanooni istemal.
